hypothesis.title: Radiomics-derived CT imaging signature predicts high‑risk neuroblastoma patients
hypothesis.intervention: Application of a radiomics‑derived imaging signature derived from CT scans
hypothesis.outcome: Accurate prediction of high‑risk disease status
hypothesis.clinical_context: Risk stratification to guide treatment intensity in neuroblastoma patients

plan.study_goal: Radiomics-derived CT imaging signature predicts high‑risk neuroblastoma patients

steps.name: Study Design Specification
steps.description: Choose a multicenter, retrospective‑prospective cohort design. Retrospectively gather CT scans and clinical data from diagnosed patients (training cohort) and prospectively enroll a new cohort for external validation. Define inclusion criteria (e.g., age < 18 years, histologically confirmed neuroblastoma, baseline contrast‑enhanced CT within 30 days of diagnosis) and exclusion criteria (e.g., poor‑quality scans, prior therapy before imaging).
